description: Add up to 300 leads to a static list by id. Write action.
embedding_description: Add existing leads to a Marketo static list (segment membership) by list id and up to 300 lead ids — membership only, does NOT change any lead field values (use create_or_update_leads for that) and does NOT trigger any campaign by itself.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with results (Marketo's per-record array: id, status [added/skipped]), row_count, and tallies (a status -> count summary).
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Summarize the tallies (e.g. '10 added, 2 skipped: already a member').

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Add a batch of leads to a static list in the configured Marketo instance.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: marketo.invalid_params: missing list_id/lead_ids or more than 300 ids. marketo.object_not_found: the list_id doesn't exist. marketo.auth_failed: OAuth credentials rejected. marketo.permission_denied: the API user's Role lacks Read-Write Person (confirmed to gate list-membership writes) — this write permission is NOT checked by check_setup, so this may be the FIRST signal of the gap.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: marketo.object_not_found: confirm the list_id via list_static_lists. marketo.permission_denied: add 'Read-Write Person' under Admin > Users & Roles > Roles > <the API role> > Access API, then retry. Individual skipped records (e.g. already a member) are in the results array, not an error.
